entries.heading: Section 165 of the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2022
ancestors: DIVISION C—DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 8149.  Section 165 of the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2022 
(division A of Public Law 117-43) shall be 
amended by striking ``$53,000,000'' and inserting ``$85,250,000''.
